fields.name: region
fields.description: The AWS region.

fields.name: log_group_name
fields.description: The name of the CloudWatch Log Group that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: log_group_template
fields.description: Template for Log Group name using Fluent Bit [record_accessor](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/administration/configuring-fluent-bit/classic-mode/record-accessor) syntax.

fields.name: log_stream_name
fields.description: The name of the CloudWatch Log Stream that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: log_stream_prefix
fields.description: Prefix for the Log Stream name.

fields.name: log_stream_template
fields.description: Template for Log Stream name using Fluent Bit [record_accessor](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/administration/configuring-fluent-bit/classic-mode/record-accessor) syntax.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record will be sent to CloudWatch.

fields.name: log_format
fields.description: An optional parameter that can be used to tell CloudWatch the format of the data.

fields.name: role_arn
fields.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume (for cross account access).

fields.name: auto_create_group
fields.description: Automatically create the log group.

fields.name: log_retention_days
fields.description: If set to a number greater than zero, and newly create log group's retention policy is set to this many days.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom endpoint for the CloudWatch Logs API.

fields.name: metric_namespace
fields.description: An optional string representing the CloudWatch namespace for the metrics.

fields.name: metric_dimensions
fields.description: A list of lists containing the dimension keys that will be applied to all metrics.

fields.name: sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom STS endpoint for the AWS STS API.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Option to specify an AWS Profile for credentials.

fields.name: auto_retry_requests
fields.description: Immediately retry failed requests to AWS services once.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Specify an external ID for the STS API, can be used with the role_arn parameter if your role requires an external ID.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
